entities.summary: Kevin Allen Loder is an American former professional basketball player who was selected by the Kansas City Kings in the first round of the 1981 NBA draft. A 6-foot-6-inch (1.98 m) swingman born in Cassopolis, Michigan, Loder played in three NBA seasons from 1981 to 1984. He played for the Kings and San Diego Clippers.
